title: GitHub Posture Collector Output
description: Security posture metrics for a GitHub organization. The whole artifact is audit-level. A trust run writes only the normalized vcs-posture, access-posture, and vuln-scanning artifacts.

schema_version.description: Schema version for this output format. Audit and internal fields are optional and additive.
schema_version.x-epack-summary: Identifies which version of the report layout this file follows.

collected_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the data was collected
collected_at.x-epack-summary: When this snapshot of the organization was taken.

collected_at_level.description: The collection level this artifact was gathered at. trust = org-level aggregates only; audit = per-repo configs + member/repo inventories + alert counts; internal = per-user activity, findings inventories, and the audit-log slice. Levels are cumulative.

organization.description: Login of the GitHub organization collected.
organization.x-epack-summary: The GitHub organization this report covers.

scope.description: The repositories collection covered: the include and exclude patterns, the GitHub App's repository selection, and the repository counts the percentages are taken over.
scope.x-epack-summary: Which repositories were included or excluded, and how much of the org that covered.

include_patterns.description: Glob patterns for repositories to include. ["*"] when the configuration sets none.
include_patterns.x-epack-summary: Glob patterns for the repositories to assess. When none are set, every repository matches.

exclude_patterns.description: Glob patterns for repositories to leave out. Exclude patterns win over include patterns.
exclude_patterns.x-epack-summary: Glob patterns for repositories to leave out of the assessment. A repository that matches both lists is left out.

repository_selection.x-epack-null: GitHub does not say which repositories a token other than an installation token can read
repository_selection.description: all when the GitHub App is installed on every repository in the organization, or selected when it is installed only on the repositories chosen for it. Repositories outside the selection are not assessed, and they count toward repository_count the way excluded ones do. Null for a token other than an installation token, or when the App's selection could not be read.
repository_selection.x-epack-summary: Whether the collector's GitHub App is installed on all of the organization's repositories or only on selected ones. Not collected for a personal access token, or when the App's selection could not be read.

repositories_coverage.description: Percentage of organization repositories covered by the assessment. Null when the organization has no repositories, when the repository list could not be read, or when repository_count is null.
repositories_coverage.x-epack-summary: Percent of the org's repositories that were in scope. Archived repositories, and repositories the collector's GitHub App is not installed on, count toward the total but are never in scope.

repositories_present.description: Whether any repository is in scope. When false, the branch protection and security feature percentages are null. Null when the repository list could not be read.
repositories_present.x-epack-summary: Whether any repository is in scope.
repositories_present.x-epack-method: Lists the organization's repositories and checks whether any of them is in scope.

repository_count.description: Repositories in the organization, archived and excluded ones included. For a GitHub App installed on selected repositories, this is GitHub's own count, public_repos plus owned_private_repos, so it includes the repositories outside the selection. Null when the repository list could not be read, or for such an App when GitHub hides its count, which it shows only to organization owners, or counts fewer repositories than the App lists.
repository_count.x-epack-summary: Number of repositories in the org, including archived and excluded ones and any the collector's GitHub App is not installed on. Share of repositories assessed is the repositories assessed as a percentage of this number.
repository_count.x-epack-method: Counts every repository in the organization's repository list. With a GitHub App installed on selected repositories, it adds the organization's public_repos and owned_private_repos instead.

included_repository_count.description: Repositories in scope: not archived, matching the include and exclude patterns, and for a GitHub App installed on selected repositories, in its selection. The branch protection and security feature percentages are over these. Null when the repository list could not be read.
included_repository_count.x-epack-summary: Number of unarchived repositories that match an include pattern and no exclude pattern. For a GitHub App installed on selected repositories, only those in its selection count.
included_repository_count.x-epack-method: Counts the listed repositories that are not archived and match the include and exclude patterns. With a GitHub App installed on selected repositories, only the ones in its selection count.

posture.x-epack-summary: Top-line adoption of branch protection and security features across repositories.

branch_protection_coverage.description: Percentage of repositories whose default branch is protected by a classic branch protection rule or by an active ruleset that supplies at least one of the branch_protection_rules rules. Null when any repository's protection could not be determined; diagnostics say why.
branch_protection_coverage.x-epack-summary: Percent of in-scope repositories whose default branch is protected by a classic branch protection rule, or by an active ruleset that applies at least one code change safeguard.

protected_repository_count.description: Repositories whose default branch is protected by a classic branch protection rule or by an active ruleset that supplies at least one of the branch_protection_rules rules. Null when any repository's protection could not be determined.
protected_repository_count.x-epack-summary: Number of in-scope repositories whose default branch is protected by a classic branch protection rule, or by an active ruleset that applies at least one code change safeguard.

security_features_coverage.description: Average coverage across all 5 security features. Null when any feature could not be read for any repository.
security_features_coverage.x-epack-summary: Average enablement across the five security features, as a percent.

access_control.description: Organization-level access control settings. Note: SSO status is not included because GitHub does not provide a reliable API to detect SAML SSO configuration.

two_factor_required.description: Whether the organization requires two-factor authentication for every member. Null when GitHub withholds the setting, as it does from callers without organization owner rights, such as a GitHub App without organization Administration read access.
two_factor_required.x-epack-summary: Whether the organization requires every member to use two-factor authentication. Not collected without organization owner rights or, for a GitHub App, organization Administration read access.

default_repository_permission.description: Audit level and above. The base permission every member has on every repository: read, write, admin, or none. Absent when GitHub withholds it, which it does unless the caller is an organization owner.
default_repository_permission.x-epack-summary: The permission every member gets on repositories by default.

members_can_create_repositories.description: Audit level and above. Whether members can create repositories. Absent when GitHub withholds it, which it does unless the caller is an organization owner.
members_can_create_repositories.x-epack-summary: Whether ordinary members may create repositories.

branch_protection_rules.description: Per-rule coverage percentages of effective default-branch protection. A rule is in place on a repository when its classic branch protection rule or an active repository, organization, or enterprise ruleset supplies it. Rulesets in evaluate or disabled enforcement do not count. A percentage is null when the rule could not be determined for at least one repository, for example because GitHub refused the request for a repository's ruleset rules; diagnostics say why.
branch_protection_rules.x-epack-summary: How widely each default-branch safeguard is in place across repositories. A safeguard counts when a classic branch protection rule or an active ruleset applies it.

pull_request_required.description: Percentage of repositories requiring a pull request before merging
pull_request_required.x-epack-summary: Percent of in-scope repositories whose default branch requires a pull request before merging.

approving_reviews.description: Percentage of repositories requiring at least one approving review
approving_reviews.x-epack-summary: Percent of in-scope repositories whose default branch requires at least one approving review before merging.

dismiss_stale_reviews.description: Percentage of repositories that dismiss approvals when new commits are pushed
dismiss_stale_reviews.x-epack-summary: Percent of in-scope repositories where a new commit dismisses earlier approvals on the default branch.

code_owner_reviews.description: Percentage of repositories requiring review from code owners
code_owner_reviews.x-epack-summary: Percent of in-scope repositories whose default branch requires review from code owners.

status_checks.description: Percentage of repositories requiring status checks to pass before merging
status_checks.x-epack-summary: Percent of in-scope repositories whose default branch requires status checks to pass before merging.

signed_commits.description: Percentage of repositories requiring signed commits
signed_commits.x-epack-summary: Percent of in-scope repositories whose default branch requires signed commits.

admin_enforcement.x-epack-null: A repository role or an actor type GitHub does not document may bypass a ruleset, so whether administrators are held to its rules cannot be told
admin_enforcement.description: Percentage of repositories where administrators are held to every protection rule on the default branch. Administrators are held to a rule when a classic rule supplying it enforces on admins, or when a ruleset supplying it lets no admin role bypass it. Null when the answer depends on a ruleset whose bypass list the token cannot see, or that lets a repository role bypass it.
admin_enforcement.x-epack-summary: Percent of in-scope repositories whose default branch is protected, with administrators held to every rule. Not collected when a ruleset's bypass list is hidden or names a repository role.

force_pushes_blocked.description: Percentage of repositories blocking force pushes to the default branch
force_pushes_blocked.x-epack-summary: Percent that block force pushes to the default branch.

deletions_blocked.description: Percentage of repositories blocking deletion of the default branch
deletions_blocked.x-epack-summary: Percent that block deletion of the default branch.

linear_history.description: Percentage of repositories requiring a linear history (no merge commits) on the default branch
linear_history.x-epack-summary: Percent that require a linear history, which blocks merge commits on the default branch.

repository_counts.description: How many repositories have each rule, the counts the percentages are taken of. A count is null when its percentage is, except that with no repository in scope the counts are 0 and the percentages null.
repository_counts.x-epack-summary: How many repositories have each safeguard. These are the counts behind the percentages above.

pull_request_required.description: Repositories requiring a pull request before merging
pull_request_required.x-epack-summary: Number of in-scope repositories whose default branch requires a pull request before merging.
pull_request_required.x-epack-method: Reads each in-scope repository's classic branch protection rule and the active rulesets on its default branch, and counts the repositories where any of them requires a pull request before merging.

approving_reviews.description: Repositories requiring at least one approving review
approving_reviews.x-epack-summary: Number of in-scope repositories whose default branch requires at least one approving review before merging.
approving_reviews.x-epack-method: Reads each in-scope repository's classic branch protection rule and the active rulesets on its default branch, and counts the repositories where any of them requires at least one approving review.

dismiss_stale_reviews.description: Repositories that dismiss approvals when new commits are pushed
dismiss_stale_reviews.x-epack-summary: Number of in-scope repositories where a new commit dismisses earlier approvals on the default branch.
dismiss_stale_reviews.x-epack-method: Reads each in-scope repository's classic branch protection rule and the active rulesets on its default branch, and counts the repositories where any of them dismisses approvals when new commits are pushed.

code_owner_reviews.description: Repositories requiring review from code owners
code_owner_reviews.x-epack-summary: Number of in-scope repositories whose default branch requires review from code owners.
code_owner_reviews.x-epack-method: Reads each in-scope repository's classic branch protection rule and the active rulesets on its default branch, and counts the repositories where any of them requires review from code owners.

status_checks.description: Repositories requiring status checks to pass before merging
status_checks.x-epack-summary: Number of in-scope repositories whose default branch requires status checks to pass before merging.
status_checks.x-epack-method: Reads each in-scope repository's classic branch protection rule and the active rulesets on its default branch, and counts the repositories where any of them requires status checks to pass.

signed_commits.x-epack-summary: Number of in-scope repositories whose default branch requires signed commits.
signed_commits.x-epack-method: Reads each in-scope repository's classic branch protection rule and the active rulesets on its default branch, and counts the repositories where any of them requires signed commits.

admin_enforcement.x-epack-null: A repository role or an actor type GitHub does not document may bypass a ruleset, so whether administrators are held to its rules cannot be told
admin_enforcement.description: Repositories where administrators are held to every protection rule on the default branch. Administrators are held to a rule when a classic rule supplying it enforces on admins, or when a ruleset supplying it lets no admin role bypass it. Null when the answer depends on a ruleset whose bypass list the token cannot see, or that lets a repository role bypass it.
admin_enforcement.x-epack-summary: Number of in-scope repositories whose default branch is protected, with administrators held to every rule.
admin_enforcement.x-epack-method: Counts the in-scope repositories where each protection rule on the default branch comes from a classic rule enforced on admins or from a ruleset whose bypass list leaves out organization admins.

force_pushes_blocked.description: Repositories blocking force pushes to the default branch
force_pushes_blocked.x-epack-summary: Number of repositories that block force pushes to the default branch.
force_pushes_blocked.x-epack-method: Reads each in-scope repository's classic branch protection rule and the active rulesets on its default branch, and counts the repositories where any of them blocks force pushes.

deletions_blocked.description: Repositories blocking deletion of the default branch
deletions_blocked.x-epack-summary: Number of repositories that block deletion of the default branch.
deletions_blocked.x-epack-method: Reads each in-scope repository's classic branch protection rule and the active rulesets on its default branch, and counts the repositories where any of them blocks deleting the branch.

linear_history.description: Repositories requiring a linear history (no merge commits) on the default branch
linear_history.x-epack-summary: Number of repositories that require a linear history on the default branch.
linear_history.x-epack-method: Reads each in-scope repository's classic branch protection rule and the active rulesets on its default branch, and counts the repositories where any of them requires a linear history.

security_features.description: Per-feature coverage percentages for security features
security_features.x-epack-summary: How widely automated security tools are enabled across repositories.

vulnerability_alerts.description: Percentage of repositories with vulnerability alerts enabled. Null when it could not be read for every repository.
vulnerability_alerts.x-epack-summary: Percent with Dependabot vulnerability alerts enabled.

code_scanning.description: Percentage of repositories with code scanning enabled. Null when it could not be read for every repository.
code_scanning.x-epack-summary: Percent of in-scope repositories where code scanning runs, through default setup or a workflow that uploads analyses.

secret_scanning.description: Percentage of repositories with secret scanning enabled. Null when it could not be read for every repository.

secret_scanning_push_protection.description: Percentage of repositories with secret scanning push protection enabled. Null when it could not be read for every repository.
secret_scanning_push_protection.x-epack-summary: Percent with secret-scanning push protection enabled.

dependabot_security_updates.description: Percentage of repositories with Dependabot security updates enabled. Null when it could not be read for every repository.
dependabot_security_updates.x-epack-summary: Percent with automated Dependabot security update pull requests enabled.

repository_counts.description: How many repositories have each feature enabled, the counts the percentages are taken of. A count is null when its percentage is, except that with no repository in scope the counts are 0 and the percentages null.
repository_counts.x-epack-summary: How many repositories have each security feature enabled. These are the counts behind the percentages above.

vulnerability_alerts.description: Repositories with vulnerability alerts enabled. Null when it could not be read for every repository.
vulnerability_alerts.x-epack-summary: Number of repositories with Dependabot vulnerability alerts enabled.
vulnerability_alerts.x-epack-method: Counts the in-scope repositories whose hasVulnerabilityAlertsEnabled is true in the GraphQL repository list.

code_scanning.description: Repositories with code scanning enabled. Null when it could not be read for every repository.
code_scanning.x-epack-summary: Number of in-scope repositories where code scanning runs, through default setup or a workflow that uploads analyses.
code_scanning.x-epack-method: Counts the in-scope repositories where code scanning default setup is configured or the code scanning analyses list holds at least one analysis.

secret_scanning.description: Repositories with secret scanning enabled. Null when it could not be read for every repository.
secret_scanning.x-epack-summary: Number of repositories with secret scanning enabled.
secret_scanning.x-epack-method: Reads each in-scope repository's security_and_analysis settings and counts the repositories where secret scanning is enabled.

secret_scanning_push_protection.description: Repositories with secret scanning push protection enabled. Null when it could not be read for every repository.
secret_scanning_push_protection.x-epack-summary: Number of repositories with secret-scanning push protection enabled.
secret_scanning_push_protection.x-epack-method: Reads each in-scope repository's security_and_analysis settings and counts the repositories where secret scanning push protection is enabled.

dependabot_security_updates.description: Repositories with Dependabot security updates enabled. Null when it could not be read for every repository.
dependabot_security_updates.x-epack-summary: Number of repositories with automated Dependabot security update pull requests enabled.
dependabot_security_updates.x-epack-method: Reads each in-scope repository's security_and_analysis settings and counts the repositories where Dependabot security updates are enabled.

per_repo.description: Audit level and above. One row per in-scope repository: the security features behind the percentages above, and its open alerts by type. A value is null when it could not be read.
per_repo.x-epack-summary: One row per in-scope repository, with its security features and open alert counts.

repository.x-epack-summary: Which repository this security-settings row describes.

vulnerability_alerts.description: Whether Dependabot alerts (vulnerability alerts) are on.
vulnerability_alerts.x-epack-summary: Whether this repository has Dependabot vulnerability alerts enabled.

code_scanning.description: Whether code scanning runs on the repository, through default setup or through any analysis a workflow uploads.
code_scanning.x-epack-summary: Whether code scanning runs on this repository, through default setup or a workflow that uploads analyses.

secret_scanning.x-epack-summary: Whether this repository has secret scanning enabled.

secret_scanning_push_protection.description: Whether secret scanning push protection is on.
secret_scanning_push_protection.x-epack-summary: Whether this repository blocks pushes that contain detected secrets.

dependabot_security_updates.description: Whether Dependabot security updates are on.
dependabot_security_updates.x-epack-summary: Whether this repository auto-opens Dependabot pull requests to fix vulnerable dependencies.

open_secret_scanning_alerts.x-epack-null: The listing reached the 5,001 alerts the collector reads per type, so the repository may have more and the count is not given
open_secret_scanning_alerts.description: Open secret scanning alerts, from the same listing as the findings inventory, so the two agree. 0 when GitHub reports secret scanning alerts are not on for the repository.
open_secret_scanning_alerts.x-epack-summary: Number of open secret-scanning alerts in this repository. It is 0 when secret scanning is off for the repository.

open_code_scanning_alerts.x-epack-null: The listing reached the 5,001 alerts the collector reads per type, so the repository may have more and the count is not given
open_code_scanning_alerts.description: Open code scanning alerts, from the same listing as the findings inventory, so the two agree. 0 when GitHub reports code scanning alerts are not on for the repository.
open_code_scanning_alerts.x-epack-summary: Number of open code-scanning alerts in this repository. It is 0 when code scanning is off for the repository.

open_dependabot_alerts.x-epack-null: The listing reached the 5,001 alerts the collector reads per type, so the repository may have more and the count is not given
open_dependabot_alerts.description: Open Dependabot alerts, from the same listing as the findings inventory, so the two agree. 0 when GitHub reports Dependabot alerts are not on for the repository.
open_dependabot_alerts.x-epack-summary: Number of open Dependabot alerts for vulnerable dependencies in this repository. It is 0 when Dependabot alerts are off for the repository.

findings.description: Internal level only. Open secret scanning, code scanning, and Dependabot alerts across in-scope repositories, read in the same listing as per_repo's counts. Never holds a secret's value or an advisory's text. Each list keeps at most 5,000 rows per repository and type. A repository with more keeps its highest-severity alerts, oldest first. A list is absent when it has no rows, and left out with a gap when any repository's alerts could not be read.
findings.x-epack-summary: Open secret-scanning, code-scanning, and Dependabot alerts (metadata only, no secret values).

secret_scanning.x-epack-summary: Open alerts where a credential or token pattern was detected in code. The secret value itself is never fetched or emitted.

code_scanning.x-epack-summary: Open alerts from static analysis of source code (for example CodeQL findings).

dependabot.x-epack-summary: Open alerts for dependencies with known vulnerabilities. The advisory text is left out.

truncated.description: Present and true when a repository had more than 5,000 open alerts of one type, so its rows stop at 5,000.
truncated.x-epack-summary: True if any repository had more than 5,000 open alerts of one type, so the inventory is partial.

truncated_dropped.description: Rows left out at the 5,000-row cap. The collector reads at most 5,001 alerts per repository and type, so a repository with more drops more than this counts.
truncated_dropped.x-epack-summary: Number of alerts left out at the cap of 5,000 per repository and alert type. When a repository has more than 5,001 open alerts of one type, more were left out than this counts.

members.description: Audit level and above. Members and outside collaborators: counts, plus each person's login, display name, role, and SAML NameID at audit; two-factor status and last activity at internal. A count is null, and per_member is left out, when the roster it needs could not be read.
members.x-epack-summary: Counts of members, owners, and outside collaborators.

member_count.x-epack-null: The member list reached the 50,000 logins the collector reads, so the organization may have more members and the count is not given
member_count.description: Organization members, owners included. Outside collaborators are counted separately.
member_count.x-epack-summary: Number of organization members, owners included. Outside collaborators are counted separately.

admin_count.x-epack-null: The owner list reached the 50,000 logins the collector reads, so the organization may have more owners and the count is not given
admin_count.description: Organization owners. Null when the owner roster could not be read.
admin_count.x-epack-summary: Number of members with the owner (admin) role.

outside_collaborator_count.x-epack-null: The outside collaborator list reached the 50,000 logins the collector reads, so there may be more outside collaborators and the count is not given
outside_collaborator_count.description: Outside collaborators: people with access to a repository who are not members. Null when that roster could not be read.
outside_collaborator_count.x-epack-summary: Number of outside collaborators with repository access.

has_pending_invitations.description: Whether an invitation to join the organization is pending. Null when invitations could not be read.
has_pending_invitations.x-epack-summary: Whether any organization invitations are outstanding.

truncated.description: Present and true when per_member was cut short at 10,000 rows, or when the member or outside collaborator list reached the 50,000 logins the collector reads.
truncated.x-epack-summary: True if the per-member rows are partial, because they stopped at 10,000 rows or the member or outside collaborator list reached the 50,000-login limit.

per_member.description: Members, then outside collaborators who are not members, in GitHub's order. Capped at 10,000 rows. When cut short, it keeps owners first, then members, then outside collaborators, each by login. Left out when either roster could not be read.
per_member.x-epack-summary: One row per member or outside collaborator, with role, SAML identity, and two-factor status.

name.description: The display name on the person's public profile. Absent when they have not set one, and left out with a gap when it could not be read.
name.x-epack-summary: The member's public profile display name. Empty when they have not set one.

role.description: admin for an organization owner, member, or outside_collaborator. Absent for a member when the owner roster could not be read.
role.x-epack-summary: Whether this person is an organization owner (admin), a member, or an outside collaborator.

saml_name_id.description: The NameID of the member's linked SAML identity, from GitHub's GraphQL API. The identity provider sets it, often to the person's username or email address there. Absent for a member with no linked SAML identity and for outside collaborators. Left out with a gap when the SAML identities could not be read, or when the read reached the 50,000 identities the collector reads.
saml_name_id.x-epack-summary: The member's user name in the organization's SAML identity provider. Empty when they have no linked SAML identity.

two_factor_enabled.description: Internal level only. Whether the person has two-factor authentication on. It comes from GitHub's roster of members without it, or for an outside collaborator from its roster of outside collaborators without it. GitHub returns the members' roster only to organization owners. Absent for everyone a roster covers when that roster reaches the 50,000 logins the collector reads.
two_factor_enabled.x-epack-summary: Whether this person has two-factor authentication turned on. Not collected without organization owner rights.

last_activity.description: Internal level only. When the person last acted in the organization, in RFC 3339 UTC, from the security-relevant audit log events of the last 7 days. Absent when no such event names them. When audit_log.truncated is true, a person named by none of the events read is left out with a gap.
last_activity.x-epack-summary: Time of this person's most recent security-relevant audit log event in the last seven days. Absent when they have no such event in that window. Not collected when the window held 5,000 or more events and none of the most recent 5,000 names them.

truncated_dropped.description: Rows left out when per_member was cut short. The collector reads at most 50,000 logins per list, so when the member or outside collaborator list reaches that, more rows were left out than this counts.
truncated_dropped.x-epack-summary: How many member rows were dropped by the 10,000-row cap. When the member or outside collaborator list reached the 50,000-login limit, more rows were left out than this counts.

repositories.description: Audit level and above. In-scope repositories: counts by visibility plus a row per repository with its inventory metadata and default-branch protection at audit; description, topics, license, and stars at internal.
repositories.x-epack-summary: Counts of repositories by visibility and protection.

public_count.x-epack-summary: Number of in-scope repositories that are public.

private_count.x-epack-summary: Number of in-scope repositories that are private.

internal_count.description: In-scope repositories visible to the enterprise's members (internal).
internal_count.x-epack-summary: Number of in-scope repositories with internal visibility, which every member of the enterprise can see.

archived_count.description: Archived repositories in the organization, or for a GitHub App installed on selected repositories, in its selection, whether or not they match the include and exclude patterns. Archived repositories are out of scope, so none has a row in per_repo or counts toward total_count.
archived_count.x-epack-summary: Number of archived repositories in the organization, or in the GitHub App's selection when it is installed on selected repositories. These are never in scope, even when they match the include patterns.

default_branch_protected_count.description: Repositories whose default branch is protected, counted the same way as posture.branch_protection_coverage. Null when any repository's protection could not be determined.
default_branch_protected_count.x-epack-label: Repositories with a protected default branch
default_branch_protected_count.x-epack-summary: Number of in-scope repositories whose default branch is protected by a classic branch protection rule, or by an active ruleset that applies at least one code change safeguard.

truncated.description: Present and true when per_repo was cut short at 5,000 rows.
truncated.x-epack-summary: True if the org has more than 5,000 in-scope repositories and the per-repo rows are partial.

per_repo.description: One row per in-scope repository, in GitHub's order. Capped at 5,000 rows. When cut short, it keeps private repositories first, then the most recently pushed.
per_repo.x-epack-summary: One row per repository with visibility and default-branch protection detail.

description.description: Internal level only. The repository's description.

visibility.description: PUBLIC, PRIVATE, or INTERNAL, as GitHub's GraphQL API names it.
visibility.x-epack-summary: Whether the repository is public, private, or internal. A repository turning public is a material exposure change.

archived.description: Whether the repository is archived. Archived repositories are out of scope, so this is false.
archived.x-epack-summary: Whether the repository is archived. Archived repositories are out of scope, so this is always false.

is_template.description: Whether the repository is a template repository.
is_template.x-epack-summary: Whether the repository is a template used to seed new repositories.

default_branch.description: The default branch's name. Absent for an empty repository.
default_branch.x-epack-summary: Name of the default branch the protection detail describes.

created_at.description: When the repository was created, in RFC 3339 UTC.

updated_at.description: When the repository was last updated, in RFC 3339 UTC.
updated_at.x-epack-summary: When the repository was last updated.

pushed_at.description: When the repository was last pushed to, in RFC 3339 UTC.
pushed_at.x-epack-summary: When code was last pushed to the repository.

primary_language.description: The repository's main language as GitHub detects it. Absent when GitHub detects none.

size_kb.description: The repository's size in kilobytes, as GitHub reports it. Absent when 0.

topics.description: Internal level only. The repository's topics, up to 20.
topics.x-epack-summary: Topic labels applied to the repository.

license_spdx.description: Internal level only. SPDX identifier of the license GitHub detects, such as Apache-2.0.
license_spdx.x-epack-summary: The repository's license as an SPDX identifier.

stargazer_count.description: Internal level only. Stars on the repository. Absent when 0.
stargazer_count.x-epack-summary: Number of users who have starred the repository.

branch_protection.description: The default branch's classic branch protection rule as GitHub reports it. Absent when the branch has no classic rule. Rulesets are reported in effective_branch_protection and rulesets.
branch_protection.x-epack-summary: The default branch's classic branch protection rule, or absent if it has none. Protection from rulesets is under Effective default-branch protection and Rulesets.

updated_at.description: When the alert last changed, as GitHub reports it.
updated_at.x-epack-summary: When the alert was last changed.

resolved_at.description: When the alert was resolved, as GitHub reports it. Absent for an unresolved alert.
resolved_at.x-epack-summary: When the alert was resolved, if it has been.

resolved_by.description: Login of whoever resolved the alert. Absent for an unresolved alert.
resolved_by.x-epack-summary: Login of whoever resolved the alert, if resolved.

repository.x-epack-summary: Repository (owner/name) where the alert was raised.

number.description: The alert's number in the repository.
number.x-epack-summary: GitHub's per-repository alert number, for cross-reference back to the UI.

rule_id.description: The ID of the rule that raised the alert, such as go/sql-injection.
rule_id.x-epack-summary: The analysis rule that fired, naming the weakness class detected.

severity.description: The rule's severity: error, warning, note, or none.
severity.x-epack-summary: The severity of the rule that raised the alert, which is error, warning, note, or none.

state.description: The alert's state. Only open alerts are listed.
state.x-epack-summary: The alert's state. Only open alerts are listed, so this is always open.

location_path.description: Path of the file where the alert was last found. Absent when GitHub reports none.
location_path.x-epack-summary: Repository path of the file the alert points to.

created_at.description: When GitHub raised the alert, as it reports it.
created_at.x-epack-summary: When the alert was first opened.

dismissed_by.description: Login of whoever dismissed the alert. Absent for an alert not dismissed.
dismissed_by.x-epack-summary: Login of whoever dismissed the alert, if dismissed.

dismissed_reason.description: Why the alert was dismissed. Absent for an alert not dismissed.
dismissed_reason.x-epack-summary: Why the alert was dismissed, such as a false positive. Only open alerts are listed, so this is normally absent.

repository.x-epack-summary: Repository (owner/name) whose dependencies raised the alert.

number.description: The alert's number in the repository.
number.x-epack-summary: GitHub's per-repository alert number, for cross-reference back to the UI.

ecosystem.description: The package's ecosystem, such as npm, pip, or go.
ecosystem.x-epack-summary: Package ecosystem the dependency belongs to (for example npm, pip, or maven).

severity.description: The vulnerability's severity: low, medium, high, or critical.
severity.x-epack-summary: The advisory's severity, which is low, medium, high, or critical.

cve.description: The advisory's CVE ID. Absent when the advisory has none. The advisory's text is never emitted.
cve.x-epack-summary: The CVE identifier for the underlying advisory, when one is assigned.

state.description: The alert's state. Only open alerts are listed.
state.x-epack-summary: The alert's state. Only open alerts are listed, so this is always open.

created_at.description: When GitHub raised the alert, as it reports it.
created_at.x-epack-summary: When the alert was first opened.
